scripts.build:generated:pdf: node scripts/prepare-generated-tree.mjs && vivliostyle build --config vivliostyle.generated-theme.config.mjs --output output/generated-theme.pdf
scripts.build:generated:webpub: node scripts/prepare-generated-tree.mjs && vivliostyle build --config vivliostyle.generated-theme.config.mjs --output output/generated-theme-webpub --format webpub
scripts.build:package:pdf: node scripts/prepare-package-theme.mjs && vivliostyle build --config vivliostyle.config.mjs --output output/package-theme.pdf
scripts.build:package:webpub: node scripts/prepare-package-theme.mjs && vivliostyle build --config vivliostyle.config.mjs --output output/package-theme-webpub --format webpub
scripts.verify: npm run verify:webpub && npm run verify:pdf
